content:
sarah_sales: PavilionHealth (EU healthcare) wants a POC. They asked for SOC2/ISO artifacts, a signed pen-test letter, DPA, and confirmation of EU data residency. Do we have a simple handoff? POC kickoff next Wed. cc @alex_solutions

alex_solutions: We can share SOC2 summary + ISO27001 cert and a pen-test attestation draft. For the pen-test letter we need a legal signatory (we use the 'Security Contacts' template). Can we get Pavilion's signatory? Also they'll want a dedicated pricing ballpark.

james_security: For healthcare we'll also need a DPA + an updated data flow diagram showing PHI segregation. Legal needs to review any attestation before signing. I can prepare the DPA template. Also confirm if they require customer-managed KMS or standard KMS.

sarah_sales: @james_security they indicated customer-managed keys and EU-only residency. Can we support a VPC-only POC? Also they asked for an SFTP option to upload evidence.

maria_engineer: We can spin up a dedicated POC in eu-west-1 with an option for customer KMS. For artifact uploads we prefer presigned S3 links or SFTP with IP allowlist. If they want SFTP, I'll provision an upload slot. Quick presign example: 
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-poc/pavilion-health-evidence.zip --expires-in 86400
```
I'll prepare the slot and give creds once legal signs off.

alex_solutions: Pen-test letter flow: we provide an attestation signed by our CTO after PoC scope is agreed. Template here (internal): https://redwood-internal/docs/pen-test-attestation-template. We'll need their test window and allowed IP ranges.

sarah_sales: Timeline: kickoff Wed 10:00 CET, evidence delivery by Tue EOD before kickoff. Pavilion also asked whether dedicated pricing affects onboarding ETA.

alex_solutions: Dedicated adds ~2 weeks for capacity + contract/legal. For fast start we can run hosted pinned to EU region with KMS option, then migrate to Dedicated once they commit.

james_security: Action items: 1) DPA draft, 2) dataflow diagram, 3) KMS onboarding steps. I can own 1+2, ETA Mon.

maria_engineer: Upload slot provisioned: sftp-poc-179999. IP allowlist ready. I'll DM creds after legal ok. :lock:

sarah_sales: I'll ask Pavilion to confirm signatory, test window, and provide their IP ranges. @alex_solutions please share pricing ballpark in DM.

alex_solutions: Sending ballpark in DM. :thumbsup: 

delphi_bot: Ticket #POC-2024-1799 created for PavilionHealth evidence handoff — assignees: alex_solutions, james_security, maria_engineer.

sarah_sales: Great, closing loop here. Will update thread with signed pen-test letter when we receive it.
